args.title: Add S3_ENDPOINT instructions for MinIO in local setup
args.body:
File: README.md

The README's local setup steps should include instructions to set `S3_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:9000` when using MinIO to ensure uploads do not attempt to reach AWS. Additionally, note the need to create the bucket using the MinIO console prior to uploads.

label: docs
file: README.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The local setup instructions in README.md lack critical details for using MinIO: setting `S3_ENDPOINT` and creating the bucket in the MinIO console. These updates will prevent upload issues by ensuring the correct configuration.
